reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about this practice. They are true animal lovers and treat you like family. Dr. Jimenez truly cares, is very experienced, and inspires confidence. They gave terrific care to my cat for years, and when he was ready for his final visit, the tech closest to him called me personally to offer condolences and say she loved him. So heartwarming.

We’ve had such a great experience with Biscayne Vet Center. The entire staff is incredibly professional, personable, and genuinely sympathetic to the conditions and individual needs of the pets they care for.

You can tell they truly care about the animals as well as the people bringing them in. They take the time to listen, explain everything clearly, and make you feel comfortable throughout the process.

Ashley and Jason in particular have been extremely nice, genuine, and caring. Their compassion really stands out and makes a stressful situation much easier.

It’s very reassuring to have a veterinary clinic where you feel like your pet is being treated with the same care and attention they would give their own. I would absolutely recommend Biscayne Vet Center to anyone looking for a professional, compassionate, and trustworthy veterinary team.

I cannot thank Dr. Jimenez and the amazing team enough for saving my French Bulldog, Ace. He had to undergo emergency surgery on July 10, 2026, after swallowing a toy string, and the level of care, professionalism, and compassion they showed was unmatched. They walked me through everything and took such wonderful care of him during a really stressful time. Truly a top-notch veterinary team—I highly recommend them! Update — August 24, 2026: Stopped by this morning at 8:15 AM to pick up records for Trupanion, and the front desk helped me instantly with zero hassle. Still the absolute best team!
Good VET, office staff could be nicer

I can't recommend Biscayne Veterinary Center highly enough! They took exceptional care of my three rescued kittens, and I couldn't have asked for a better experience.

A special thank you to Ashley and Dr. Jimenez for their kindness, compassion, and genuine love for animals. They were patient, knowledgeable, and took the time to answer all of my questions while making sure the kittens received the best possible care.

I also truly appreciated how reasonable and fair their prices were. It's not always easy to find a veterinary clinic that combines outstanding medical care with affordability, but Biscayne Veterinary Center does exactly that.

Thank you to the entire team for helping my little kittens get healthy. I highly recommend Biscayne Veterinary Center to anyone looking for a caring, trustworthy, and professional veterinary practice!

I really wanted to like this clinic because it is close to home, easy to get an appointment, and the staff has always been friendly. Unfortunately, after multiple visits, I no longer feel confident in the care or communication.

We initially brought our cat in for a skin condition and were prescribed medication and medicated wipes. He then vomited for nine straight days. When we brought him back, they performed several tests, including X rays and a fecal test, costing about $400. After all of those tests, the veterinarian told us the prescribed medication can cause vomiting if the cat licks or ingests it. All of those tests were done for nothing when he simply could have told us the medication’s potential side effects.

We still gave the clinic another chance and returned for cat acne. The veterinarian seemed rushed, looked at his phone while my husband was asking questions, and began walking out before we felt the appointment was finished. When I asked whether the new antibiotic could also cause vomiting, he simply said he did not know.

We were also told we would receive an estimate for a dental cleaning by the end of the day, but it was never sent. I also left without clear instructions on what soap to use for cleaning our cat’s chin.

I appreciate the convenience of this clinic, but the lack of communication, follow through, and attention during appointments has made us decide to find a new veterinarian.
